Abbott’s adjusted diluted earnings per share was $1.03 (GAAP diluted EPS was $0.75), beating analyst estimates. [...] # Abbott Delivers Q1 Results

## Growth in base business and a diverse  ,portfolio create momentum for 2023.  ,

Apr. 19, 2023

Copy Link   Share on X   Share on Facebook   Share on Linkedin

At the close of the first quarter of 2023, Abbott’s latest financial results indicate growth fueled by the performance of its base business.
results.title: Abbott Delivers Q1 Results | Abbott Newsroom

results.snippet:
The company highlighted the 10% organic sales growth generated by its Medical Devices, Established Pharmaceuticals and Nutrition segments excluding COVID tests.

Still, the drop in sales had a profound impact on Abbott’s financial performance.

During the quarter, Abbott’s operating earnings were nearly halved to $1.5 billion, while net earnings fell 46.1% to $1.3 billion. [...] “Our first-quarter results reflect a very strong start to the year,” Abbott CEO Robert B. Ford said in a statement. “Growth in our underlying base businesses accelerated, including particularly strong results in Medical Devices, Established Pharmaceuticals and Nutrition.” [...] ﻿Abbott Laboratories’ reported sales fell 18.1% in Q1 due to what the company called an “anticipated decline” in COVID-19 testing-related sales compared to 2022.

Abbott’s Diagnostics segment experienced the biggest slide, with reported sales down 48.9% year-over-year. Meanwhile, when COVID tests were excluded, Diagnostics sales increased 4%.
results.title: Abbott sales 18% fall due to anticipation of COVID testing sales declines
